legal.privacyContent:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 19, 2026

1. Data Controller

DishRank SAS is responsible for processing your personal data.

DPO contact: contact@dishrank.fr

2. Data Collected

  • Sign-up: email, username, password (encrypted), profile picture.
  • Content: reviews, ratings, dish photos, comments.
  • Location: geolocation (with consent).
  • Technical: device type, OS, push notification token.

3. Purposes

  • Account management
  • Publishing and displaying your reviews
  • Recommending nearby dishes
  • Notifications (likes, comments)
  • Service improvement

4. Retention period

  • Account data: deleted within 30 days of account removal
  • Location: not stored, used in real time
  • Technical logs: 12 months maximum

5. Data sharing

  • Supabase (hosting) — servers in Europe
  • Google (push notifications, Places API)

We never sell your data.

6. Your rights (GDPR)

  • Access, rectification, erasure, portability (JSON export)
  • Objection, restriction, withdrawal of consent

Exercisable from Settings > Personal data or by email.

7. Contact

contact@dishrank.fr — DishRank SAS, Paris
legal.termsContent:
Terms of Service

Last updated: March 19, 2026

1. Acceptance

By using DishRank, you accept these Terms of Service.

2. Service description

DishRank lets you rate and share reviews on specific dishes in restaurants.

3. Sign-up

You must be at least 16 years old. You are responsible for your credentials.

4. User content

  • You are the original author of the content
  • Non-exclusive display license granted to DishRank
  • Removable at any time

5. Conduct

  • Honest and respectful use
  • No fake reviews
  • No harassment

6. Applicable law

French law. Paris courts.

7. Contact

contact@dishrank.fr
legal.deleteContent:
Account deletion

1. From the app

Profile > Settings > Personal data > Delete my account

2. By email

Send to contact@dishrank.fr with subject "Account deletion".

Data removed

  • Profile, reviews, photos, comments, likes, bookmarks, settings, notifications

30 days grace period before permanent deletion.
